description: Permanently delete a secret from the vault. This action is irreversible.
embedding_description: Vault: delete a secret. Permanently erase a stored credential, password, OAuth client_secret, API key, refresh token, or bearer token from the vault by its key. Irreversible — no version history is retained after deletion. Requires the vault to be unlocked. Use when retiring an expired or leaked credential or cleaning up after a connector teardown.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation of permanent secret deletion. Contains key (identifier) and message (status). The secret value has been permanently erased.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently deletes a secret from the vault. This operation is irreversible - the encrypted data is erased.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultLocked: Vault must be unlocked before deleting secrets. KeyNotFound: No secret exists with the specified key. PermissionDenied: User lacks permission to delete secrets.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultLocked: Prompt user to unlock vault first. For KeyNotFound: List available secrets to verify the key. For PermissionDenied: Check vault access permissions.
